name: Coroticus
text: Coroticus is the name under which the dictionary treats the sixth-century ruler Ceredig Wledig of Dumbarton in Strathclyde. Tradition ties him to the raid on the early converts of St Patrick. The reader is sent to the Ceredig Wledig article for the main account.

attributes.attribute: sixth-century ruler of Dumbarton in Strathclyde

okr.objective: Record the name Coroticus and its ruler.
key_results: Tie Coroticus to Ceredig Wledig of Dumbarton.
Give the raid on the early converts of St Patrick.
